paper_title: Getting the most on supernova axions
notes: Blue 'SN1987A (cooling)' excluded band from Fig. 3, extracted from the vector fill path of Figure3.pdf in the arXiv e-print. The paper's Lagrangian (Eq. A1) is L = g_a (d_mu a/2m_N) C_ap pbar gamma^mu gamma_5 p with g_ap = g_a C_ap, i.e. already the canonical dimensionless normalisation (no 2m_N conversion needed). Benchmark scenario: KSVZ-inspired C_ap=-0.47, C_an=0, so g_an=0 and the bound is on g_ap alone. Points trace the closed band boundary: lower (free-streaming) edge left-to-right from the plot edge at 1e-4 eV (flat at 6.2e-10, cf. quoted 6e-10) to the rounded tip at ~3.0e8 eV, then the upper (trapping) edge right-to-left back to 2.56e-6 (cf. quoted 2.5e-6); at ~90 MeV the extracted edges give 7e-10 and 3.7e-7, matching the quoted 7e-10 and 3.5e-7. Axis calibration from tick marks, verified against these four quoted values. The separate green 'SN1987A (events)' Kamiokande-II region (g_ap >~ 2.4e-7 for m_a <~ 20 eV, rising at higher mass) is NOT included; the cooling band is the paper's main result. The bound extends below the plotted minimum mass 1e-4 eV (mass-independent there). Astrophysical luminosity criterion, not a formal CL; 0.95 nominal.
